index eea7b8c4..7c2b1987 100644
--- a/docs/architecture/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.md
+++ b/docs/architecture/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.md
@@ -195,6 +195,16 @@ rows unsupported. Ordinary SQL, Python and CLI operations use the separate admit
 native relational/Vortex primitive paths. The private legacy helpers remain as
 test fixtures; a resource declaration alone does not authorize their execution.
 
+Native Vortex primitive execution on non-Unix platforms now refuses with
+`native_vortex_resource_admission` before source access or destination changes.
+Those platforms do not yet implement the shared reservation owner used by the
+Unix provider. This applies to direct, partitioned and row-export entry points,
+including metadata-only count. The CLI retains the declared allocation while
+leaving admission and measured usage unavailable. A numeric grant cannot certify
+an executor without its memory owner. Three platform-specific regression tests
+compile on Unix and run in the Windows compatibility lane; local Unix validation
+does not establish that Windows runtime result.
+
 A further review found that aggregate policy retained a 65,536-item floor even
 for sub-MiB byte declarations. Aggregate item estimates now scale from exact
 bytes; heavy-hitter windows and their route-specific choices can only narrow
diff --git a/docs/benchmarks/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.md b/docs/benchmarks/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.md
index 3b2e69a3..0f9b9000 100644
--- a/docs/benchmarks/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.md
+++ b/docs/benchmarks/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.md
@@ -265,6 +265,31 @@ checks are retained rather than described as newly executed. No Full43 rerun,
 new performance claim or package publication accompanies this Python correction.
 Fresh hosted acceptance remains required.
 
+## Non-Unix admission follow-up
+
+Review found that the older non-Unix metadata-count path could execute through
+an unbudgeted Vortex session while reporting the numeric declaration as admitted.
+All public primitive entry points now refuse on that platform before opening a
+source or changing a destination. The CLI reports declared resources and
+unavailable admission. Unix execution continues through its existing shared owner.
+
+Fresh local formatting, default workspace lint and all 3,166 default tests pass.
+Native workspace lint and all 1,338 CLI tests pass. Three new non-Unix regression
+tests compile but are explicitly ignored on this Unix host: they cover existing
+and missing inputs, one-byte and larger grants, direct/partitioned APIs, writer
+preservation and the actual CLI envelope. The Windows compatibility lane now
+executes those tests; hosted runtime proof is pending. An initial launcher used
+an older Python without `hashlib.file_digest`, and the first native lint attempt
+caught a test import from the wrong crate. Both failures are retained; the
+corrected invocation and test compile pass.
+
+The supplemental packet in the
+[evidence index](evidence/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.json) binds this
+source correction, test source, local gate outputs and CI registration. The
+preceding complete workflows and native Vortex suite remain historical evidence;
+they were not rerun for this platform refusal. No new benchmark or package
+publication accompanies the correction.
+
 ## Remaining work
 
 Hosted acceptance remains pending. The next implementation

    assert result['protocol_sha256'] == c.sha(c.OUT / f'resource-engine-{attempt}-protocol.json')
    for check in result['checks']:
        record = receipt(Path(check['receipt']).stem)
        assert record['receipt_sha256'] == check['receipt_sha256']
        assert record['receipt']['command'] == protocols[attempt]['commands'][check['name']]
        checks.append({'attempt': attempt, 'name': check['name'], **record})

changed = c.git('diff', '--name-only', head).splitlines() + [new_test]
runtime_changed = {name for name in changed if name in sources}
assert runtime_changed == {new_test, 'scripts/check_ci_gate_matrix.py',
    'shardloom-vortex/src/local_primitives.rs', 'shardloom-cli/src/vortex_primitive_execution.rs'}
scope = {name: {'after_sha256': c.sha(c.ROOT / name),
    'before_sha256': None if name == new_test else hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(
        ['git', 'show', head + ':' + name], cwd=c.ROOT)).hexdigest()} for name in changed}
patch = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', head], cwd=c.ROOT, text=True)
support = c.read(c.OUT / 'resource-support-8-results.json')
assert support['status'] == 'passed' and len(support['reports']) == 14
assert support['source_identity_sha256'] == c.identity(sources)
support_reports = []
for entry in support['reports']:
    if 'path' in entry:
        assert c.sha(entry['path']) == entry['sha256']
        support_reports.append(capture(entry['path']))
    else:
        support_reports.append(entry)
ci = c.read(c.OUT / 'resource-ci-platform-registration-report-2.json')
assert ci['status'] == 'passed' and ci['blockers'] == []
index_path = c.ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.json'
index = c.read(index_path)
assert 'non_unix_admission_review_correction' not in index
preserved = {}
for name in c.git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', head, 'docs/benchmarks/evidence').splitlines():
    if Path(name).name.startswith('required-execution-resources') and name != str(index_path.relative_to(c.ROOT)):
        before = hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', head + ':' + name], cwd=c.ROOT)).hexdigest()
        assert c.sha(c.ROOT / name) == before
        preserved[name] = before
assert len(preserved) >= 5
artifact = {
    'schema_version': 'shardloom.required_resources_non_unix_admission_correction.v1',
    'status': 'passed_local_compilation_and_unix_regression_pending_windows_runtime',
    'pr_url': 'https://github.com/depsilon/shardloom/pull/1541',
    'reviewed_head': head, 'review_comment_id': 4239581888,
    'source_hashes': sources, 'source_identity_sha256': c.identity(sources),
    'changed_files': scope, 'source_patch': patch,
    'new_platform_test': capture(c.ROOT / new_test),
    'protocols': protocols, 'results': results, 'checks': checks,
    'default_gate_source_difference': 'Only the feature-gated platform test import/format changed after the default gates; release-feature compilation validates that test.',
    'windows_runtime_executed_locally': False, 'platform_tests_ignored_on_unix': 3,
    'windows_runtime_required_before_acceptance': True,
    'native_vortex_suite_rerun': False, 'original_complete_workflows_rerun': False,
    'support': {'results': support, 'reports': support_reports,
                'receipt': receipt('resource-support-checks-8')},
    'ci_registration': {'report': ci, 'receipt': receipt('resource-ci-platform-registration-2')},
    'preserved_failures': {
        'old_python_launcher': c.read(c.OUT / 'resource-engine-12-launch-environment.json'),
        'test_import': receipt('resource-engine-native-clippy-12', 'failed'),
        'ci_documentation_registration': {'receipt': receipt('resource-ci-platform-registration-1', 'failed'),
            'report': c.read(c.OUT / 'resource-ci-platform-registration-report-1.json')},
    },
    'preserved_artifact_sha256': preserved, 'generator': capture(__file__),
    'performance_claim': False, 'whole_process_memory_limit_enforced': False,
    'fallback_attempted': False, 'external_engine_invoked': False, 'package_version': '0.5.1',
}
assert c.source_hashes() == sources
output = index_path.with_name('required-execution-resources-non-unix-admission-2026-10-10.json')
c.write(output, artifact)
assert c.read(output)['source_hashes'] == sources
index['non_unix_admission_review_correction'] = {
    'path': output.name, 'sha256': c.sha(output), 'status': artifact['status'],
    'source_identity_sha256': c.identity(sources), 'default_tests': 3166,
    'native_cli_tests': 1338, 'platform_tests_ignored_on_unix': 3,
    'windows_runtime_executed_locally': False, 'documentation_checks': 14,
    'ci_registration_passed': True, 'performance_claim': False,
}
index_path.write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': 'passed', 'artifact': str(output),
                  'bytes': output.stat().st_size, 'sha256': c.sha(output)}))
